One successful workshop or published pattern does not demonstrate changed community practice. A useful first return is a bounded contribution hypothesis with its unestablished practice effect. An observation or coordination request is a further action only when its attainable contribution warrants the whole burden for this inquiry. If nobody is entitled to receive or act on the requested community-wide advice, return that recipient or authority gap. Do not invent community consent from a meeting attendance list.


### DOCA.Application:3.2 - AI/model or composite arrangement

A service team is the recipient of an inquiry about a named AI-assisted review configuration. The development subject is the specified model, data, scaffold, tools, code, oversight and operating arrangement—not an assumed human-like learner. DOCA can contrast parameter, data, scaffold, tool, evaluation, oversight and non-AI support changes.

The first useful result is a contribution-bearing configuration or an exact AI/engineering evaluation gap. The direct practices own performance, safety, security, data access and operational evidence. A result for configuration A does not qualify configuration B because the provider or model family is the same. Human curriculum, motivation, cognitive-load and transfer mechanisms do not transfer by analogy.

The team's authorized operational owner retains deployment or probe choice. AI helping to draft the advice invokes the adviser's own review and information-use obligations; it does not fill the developing subject's evaluation gap.


### DOCA.Application:3.3 - Engineered platform or facility

A laboratory-platform owner asks which change could improve access to a shared instrument without degrading calibration or safety. DOCA bounds the facility configuration, receiving experiments, horizon, users, downtime, calibration and resource protections. Directions may involve scheduling, support, interfaces, a component change or a separate provider.

The smallest result may be a qualified support opportunity or a conditional transition. Systems/Platform Engineering supplies architecture and realization; operations, domain measurement and safety practices supply their direct results. A changed interface may make an existing instrument capability more usable; any claimed new measuring capability still needs its own qualification. Fewer support calls do not prove preserved measurement quality. Missing calibration or safety evidence blocks the dependent use, not every independent facility improvement.


### DOCA.Application:3.4 - Research programme or body of knowledge

An actual research lead receives a question about the next contribution to a reproducibility programme. The subject is the specified research arrangement or body of knowledge, and the intended contribution might be a replicated result, corrected claim, discriminating experiment or reusable analysis.

DOCA can construct and retain those opportunities under a stated horizon and burden. Research and evidence practices own the criticism, reproducibility, formalization, empirical result and inference. A sequence of pattern contributions is prospective guidance, not completed research or a capability finding. If an earlier report is corrected, DOCA.8 follows its actual receiving use; A.10.1 applies when several affected receivers must be discovered. Return the precise evidence question or supported epistemic contribution.


### DOCA.Application:3.5 - Non-cultural population or lineage

In this evolutionary research account, the population has no population-local advice recipient or chooser. DOCA abstains from advice to it. Variation, reproduction, selection, persistence and lineage remain the direct subject of the relevant scientific practices, not a human programme in another vocabulary.

A researcher who asks whether to change an experiment or conservation intervention is a different case. The researcher or authorized organization is the recipient; the population remains an affected subject. Its evidence, welfare/protection conditions, governance and intervention authority must be qualified by their actual owners.


### DOCA.Application:3.6 - What the contrast preserves

Across these uses, keep the identified subject, receiving contribution, horizon, protections, source limits and first useful return. Do not transfer a person's mastery reading, a team's authority, an AI benchmark, a facility's calibration or a research claim into another branch without its qualified receiving basis. When the necessary recipient, meaning, permission or evidence is missing, the useful result can be an exact request, narrower claim or abstention.

## DOCA.Application:End


# Framework boundary, sources and refresh


## DOCA.Reference:1 - Covered work and independent entry

The field is conducting and improving a named subject's development, including self-development when that subject contributes to conducting its own development. Recurring questions include unnoticed difficulty, an unformed aspiration, construction of a worthwhile problem, reachable directions and means, joint provision, enactment, actual changed possibilities and continuation after success. Ordinary work, implementation, advice, learning and Method creation can each contribute; none alone defines the whole.

DOCA.9 constructs the connected undertaking using the qualified subject and professional results it needs. DOCA.10 constructs a feasible portfolio for an organization or provider with independently worthwhile undertakings and shared means. Opportunity construction uses DOCA.1, DOCA.1.CHR and DOCA.2–6 without requiring an adviser. Advising can start with a formed question, qualified opportunity or existing HCD.2 programme comparison. Shared inquiry, characterization, joint conditions and changed-premise qualification remain results to obtain when missing, not mandatory checkpoints.

The publication includes the complete eleven pattern bodies, their material connections and heterogeneous worked uses. It deliberately does not reproduce every engineering, learning, cultural, research, financial or legal mechanism needed by every development subject. The direct supplier result and conditions remain part of the receiving construction. If that result is unavailable, keep the particular gap; a coherent network drawing does not close it.

The cross-pattern applications preserve a person-to-Guide use, an organization inquiry and unlike subjects. DOCA.9 adds a connected undertaking with two substantive development transitions and changed performing arrangements. DOCA.10 adds a provider portfolio, a decision-reversing resource change and an external research partner. These are teaching cases, not an empirical coverage claim or the Method's scope boundary.

### DOCA.Reference:3.3 - Direct frameworks, predecessor sources, and honest omissions

[Problem Structuring and Decision Support](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/Development%20DPF%20Suite/PROBLEM-STRUCTURING-AND-DECISION-SUPPORT-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) supplies its direct generic inquiry, comparison, recommendation and follow-up contributions. [Human Capability Development](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/Development%20DPF%20Suite/HUMAN-CAPABILITY-DEVELOPMENT-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) supplies personal demand, programme and evidence contributions. [OCE.8](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/Engineering%20DPF%20Suite/ORGANIZATION-CHANGE-ENGINEERING-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#oce8---compare-human-ai-robotic-and-provider-arrangements-for-the-same-organizational-work-result) supplies whole-arrangement construction and comparison when that same-result question is current. Their use is claim-specific; a bibliography entry is not proof of dependency or client adequacy.

The [predecessor opportunity-construction description](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/Development%20DPF%20Suite/PROBLEM-STRUCTURING-AND-DECISION-SUPPORT-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#construct-a-bounded-development-opportunity), [advising profile](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/Development%20DPF%20Suite/PROBLEM-STRUCTURING-AND-DECISION-SUPPORT-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#development-direction-advising) and [source-responsibility account](#docareference54---predecessor-source-account-access) remain distinct sources, with their public expressions and access limits identified below. Their construction moves are carried by DOCA.1–DOCA.6, their actual engagement conditions by DOCA.7, and their affected-opportunity return by DOCA.8. Generic recommendation and follow-up continue to return to PSD.

The [Foundations programme](#docareference53---foundations-programme-source-access) and [comparison](#docareference53---foundations-programme-source-access) illustrate a programme design considered before a particular person's development question. A learner-oriented narrative can arrange explanations and practice for learning; a compact pattern body helps a practitioner select a move for a working difficulty. For a particular person's capability, programme fit or learning result, use the relevant direct practices and observations.

Broader career-design exercises, motivation and learning-science accounts, real-options valuation, specialist investment valuation, complete professional certification, legal/safety compliance and domain implementation are not reproduced here. Their omission is not permission to bypass them when a receiving claim needs them. Return that exact question to its actual current owner.

### DOCA.Reference:3.4 - Connected development and the portfolio construction

DOCA.9 combines the developed Library contributions to problematisation, Method construction, transformation-flow description, capability development and cultural continuation. B.5.PI, C.39, C.40.CD/CU, E.18/E.18.NET, C.32.MWA, E.23.CDI and C.36/C.36.RP retain their precise subjects and conditions. A.12 retains the internal acting/changed-parts explanation where its premises hold. HCD, OCE, Method Engineering and the actual target practice retain the operations that make a subject-specific transition attainable. DOCA.9:11 compares the developed joining contribution with direct ME.6/C.40.CU/subject-Method composition, preserves the latter as an adequate cheaper stop, and identifies the exact CIPD and MIT CISR organizational sources and their adaptations. The synthesis supplies the connections and changed-condition construction, not a new universal mechanism for every development subject. In particular, the same-agent explanation in :4.2.2a connects available capability to a development operation and its receiving use; it neither replaces Reflexive Split nor infers acquisition from the description of a change.

DOCA.10 uses STR.8/11/14 for contribution and commitment construction, RMP.1/2/8 for independent epistemic purposes and attainable inquiry, MA.1–3/8 for scarce demand and time-related obligations, and OCE.8/9/11 for obtaining and realizing support while current work continues. Its original OECD comparison and transfer limit are stated in DOCA.10:11. In particular, the mission-portfolio source does not make independent science subordinate to the next commercial release.

The role-community essays cited by DOCA.9 contribute overlapping organizational/community relations, participant journeys and competing formal/informal influence. They are conceptual sources from 2024, not evidence that every office disappears or that AI universally replaces human contributions. Their useful source question is how the participant's own purpose, burden and authority changes the proposed provision.

These constructions can be examined through their intermediate results, whole conditions and changed cases. Their worked examples are stipulated explanations, not observations of organizational effectiveness or any provider's actual resources. Reopen a dependent move when subject evidence, a supplier or practical use defeats its connection. An adequate direct Method retains its stopping power.


## DOCA.Reference:4 - Requalification and guidance refresh

For a changed client fact, configuration, support, use, horizon or service condition, use DOCA.8 to find the smallest affected opportunity result. Preserve independent qualified uses, historical advice and actual prior configurations. A narrowed data class needs its own quantities and comparisons; a missed necessary observation limits only the reliance that needed it.

For a changed development undertaking, DOCA.9 reconnects the affected receiving work, provision and continuation. For a changed shared contribution, timing or allocation, DOCA.10 reconstructs its affected portfolio uses without inventing dependencies for independent branches. Use DOCA.8 for the opportunity claims whose premises changed; it need not absorb the whole enactment or resource decision.

For a changed source claim with several receiving uses, A.10.1 supplies bounded discovery and actual dependence before each direct practice qualifies its result. For source currentness, decay or scoped refresh, use G.11. A moved file with unchanged accessible claims can require only a repaired reference; an uninspected receiver or expired reliance window cannot be declared unchanged for convenience.

When a source or practitioner result defeats the guidance itself, send the precise failed move, receiving use, source difference and candidate repair to the responsible framework maintainer. Change only the dependent body, relation, entry or example unless the field or branch boundary is genuinely defeated. Updating a client account is not automatically a framework revision; updating a publication date is not a new qualification.


## DOCA.Reference:5 - Reading the references

All eleven DOCA bodies are included in this publication. Internal links use GitHub's native heading fragments. If a Markdown reader uses another heading-address convention, use its document outline or search for the exact heading. Other framework and domain sources remain external. Their public URLs remain usable when this Markdown file is copied elsewhere, provided network access and the supplying publication remain available. This is not an offline-complete source collection.

Use a supplying source for the exact contribution and conditions named by the receiving claim. A working link does not establish that a result fits the subject, configuration, use or horizon. If the source or its necessary qualification cannot be obtained, retain the exact gap and use only independently supported contributions.


### DOCA.Reference:5.1 - FPF source locators

The complete [FPF Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ailev/FPF/main/FPF-Spec.md) is available as a raw file. GitHub's [file page](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md) may refuse to render the large document. Open or save the raw Markdown in a text or Markdown reader and search for the following PatternID and heading. FPF links in this publication return to that full file, not to a promised rendered fragment.

| FPF PatternID | Source heading to locate |
| --- | --- |
| A.2.3 | `U.PromiseContent` — Promised Outcomes and Acceptance Criteria |
| A.3.1 | U.Method: Reusable Way of Doing with Explicit Applicability |
| A.3.2 | U.MethodDescription: Description Episteme for a Way of Doing |
| A.10.1 | Revalidate Affected Uses When a Relied-on Source Changes |
| A.15.9 | Use or Request a Bounded Result from Another Practice |
| C.11.CRC | Configuration-Relative Contribution Comparison |
| C.11.DUA | Make Advice and Evidence Demands Worth Their Burden |
| C.16 | Measurement & Metrics Characterization (MM‑CHR) |
| C.17 | Characterising Generative Novelty and Value |
| C.18 | Open-Ended Search Archive and Front Stewardship |
| C.19 | Explore-Exploit Live-Pool Governor |
| C.40 | Develop Branching Search from Reusable Material |
| C.40.CD | Develop Problems and Ways of Solving Them Together |
| E.10.DEV | Recovering What Development or Evolution Means in the Current Claim |
| G.11 | Decide Whether and How to Refresh (Telemetry and Decay) |
| B.5.PI | Locate the complete problematisation pattern by this PatternID. |
| C.32.MWA | Locate the complete Method/Work architecture construction by this PatternID. |
| C.36 / C.36.RP | Locate the complete cultural-construction and reproduction pattern bodies by these PatternIDs. |
| C.39 | Find and Develop a Way to Obtain a Result |
| C.40.CU | Locate the complete reproducible-useful-whole construction by this PatternID. |
| E.18 / E.18.NET | Locate the complete transformation-flow and network pattern bodies by these PatternIDs. |
| E.23.CDI | Locate the complete capability-development pattern by this PatternID. |

Use the complete relevant pattern and its conditions, not just the matched title. In particular, A.10.1 supplies bounded changed-source discovery and actual-use qualification; DOCA.8 requires a subject basis before asserting restored qualification, but may finish with a supported limit or compatible reference repair. It does not require a second result record or an unused common summary. A different edition or wording requires comparison of the relied-on contribution when that difference could affect the receiving use.


### DOCA.Reference:5.2 - Learning Product source access

The following sources belong to the Learning Product Development LPF. Their complete texts are not included here, and this publication supplies no verified public retrieval address for them.

| Exact source | Contribution used in APP-DOCA-01 |
| --- | --- |
| LG.02 - Проектировать длинный учебный маршрут по устойчивым адресам | Place the first distinction, worked use and later varied return along a learning route with stable addresses. |
| LG.03 - Проверять законченный фрагмент руководства по следующему действию учащегося | Check whether a completed Guide fragment supports the learner's next action and identify the bounded repair. |
| LG.05 - Проектировать учебную единицу, которая учит применять паттерн | Develop a pattern-centred unit around recognition, explanation, action, result/check, a worked case and practice. |

Obtain the applicable source from the Learning Product maintainer when its full instruction is needed. LG.05 is marked Candidate in its source LPF; qualify its applicable use before treating it as established instructional guidance. The constructed DOCA application explains the requested design contribution, not the admission of that source. Without the full source or a qualified design result, retain the Guide-design question with Learning Product practice. The opportunity and programme results remain separately usable within their conditions.


### DOCA.Reference:5.3 - Foundations programme source access

**ThinkingFoundations + EngineeringFoundations** is the programme source; **Основания выбора и сравнение программ** is its supporting programme-choice and comparison account, with a source-inspection basis of 2 September 2026. They illustrate a programme design considered before a particular person's development question. Their full working texts are not included here and no verified public retrieval route is supplied.

For that illustration's complete design and comparison, request both sources from the programme's responsible designer or maintainer. For an actual person's programme question, obtain the compatible HCD.2 comparison and the person's relevant starting conditions, later tasks, support and participation. The illustration supplies none of those individual premises. A different adequate programme comparison can enter the same advice or choice question directly.


### DOCA.Reference:5.4 - Predecessor source-account access

**Development-direction profile: source responsibility and local refresh** is the full predecessor source account, whose identified qualification window is 2 September 2026. The public PSD section [Source responsibility and references](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/Development%20DPF%20Suite/PROBLEM-STRUCTURING-AND-DECISION-SUPPORT-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#psdreference5---source-responsibility-and-references) supplies a condensed source-responsibility expression, not that complete earlier account.

Use the public section for the contribution it actually states. If a historical qualification or source-use decision depends on omitted detail, obtain the full named account from PSD profile maintenance. The current DOCA source roles above remain the place to recover this publication's own bounded reliance; neither a condensed expression nor the source's date supplies an uninspected stronger claim.


### DOCA.Reference:5.5 - A useful stop when access is incomplete

A reader should be able to locate the current question, recover its first useful result or gap, and identify the source or practice that can support the stronger claim. If source access fails, keep the missing premise explicit and preserve independent qualified work. The responsible practice may supply an adequate alternative result, a narrower claim or a blocker. Publication, accessible text, recent dates and well-written examples do not supply the client's evidence or authorization.

## DOCA.Reference:6 - Edition, series and scope

**Series and current edition.** The first edition dated 12 October 2026 is the first admitted member of the Development and Self-Development Practice product series. It serves people and assisting agents arranging their own development, development of a collective, organization or another system, bounded advising, or help for others to continue development.

This publication connects opportunity construction, characterization and development-direction advice with continuing development. DOCA.1–8 and DOCA.1.CHR supply complete opportunity, characterization and advice Methods. Their results retain the stated boundaries when used in a larger undertaking.

DOCA.9 connects a consequential situation to changed possibilities and further development. DOCA.10 constructs an organization or provider portfolio for independent purposes and shared means. The Readme, Preface and source returns explain how these contributions work together. Cite the actual publication and edition used; a historical citation retains the content of that edition.

DOCA is the reference code used for the eleven Methods in this framework. The title names its practical scope; the complete Methods and qualified supplier returns supply that scope's content. PatternIDs identify contributions within the named publication; a URL fragment follows the actual Markdown heading. Suite membership is stated in the Suite account.

Admit a later edition through an explicit decision when its relation to the actual source edition is established and the complete language is qualified for this use. Retain the connection from consequential difficulty or opportunity through worthwhile attainable change and realization to further development, together with independently useful inquiry and advice. Self-development requires the developing subject's own organizing contribution. Refinement, splitting or redistribution must preserve useful operations and qualified suppliers or provide qualified replacements. Correct false claims and mistaken boundaries. Source derivation alone does not admit an edition.

Direct reliance remains contribution-specific. A changed supplier Method, professional condition or source can reopen the dependent move without invalidating the entire language. Review the affected admission or use when a required operation is lost or use exposes a consequential failure. Replacing continuing development with routine delivery or implementation alone identifies another series. Use the existing adequate contribution where it still answers the receiving question.

Loss of qualification calls for a warning and a decision about repair, withdrawal of recommendation or retirement. Superseded, unavailable or retired editions retain their historical membership while the series continues; a false admission claim requires correction. Retire the series by an explicit decision when its field and use will no longer be served or when repair after qualification loss is declined. Retirement ends its current belonging occurrences while preserving past facts; a later active collection requires a new constitution. A change of title, publication home, Suite membership or maintenance alone leaves the series identity unchanged. The constitution establishes no maintenance service, future edition or uninterrupted availability.

## DOCA.Reference:End


# SOURCE_FILE: Development DPF Suite/DEVELOPMENT-DPF-SUITE-REFERENCE.md
---
# Development DPF Suite Reference

> Find the contribution that lets development continue, and the Methods for obtaining it.

**Reference edition, 12 October 2026.** The [Suite account](README.md) states the collection, membership and identity rules. Each answer returns to the full supplying publications and their conditions of use.

Use this Reference while arranging development of yourself, a collective, an organization or another system, providing help, or supporting continued practice among independent carriers. It supplies practical entries to complete Methods, not a fixed process or an obligatory office. Open a known sufficient pattern directly. The supplying pattern's entry, conditions, worked case and return still govern its use.

Addresses `Development.Reference:n` identify sections of this Reference, not patterns. Each section includes its subordinate headings through the next heading of the same or higher level. The final boundary is `Development.Reference:End`.

## Contents

- [Development.Reference:1 - What result are we trying to obtain?](#developmentreference1---what-result-are-we-trying-to-obtain)
- [Development.Reference:2 - Where does development begin, and what happens after success?](#developmentreference2---where-does-development-begin-and-what-happens-after-success)
- [Development.Reference:3 - How do the different transformations form one undertaking?](#developmentreference3---how-do-the-different-transformations-form-one-undertaking)
- [Development.Reference:4 - Who should perform and support the Methods?](#developmentreference4---who-should-perform-and-support-the-methods)
- [Development.Reference:5 - Which directions can we undertake together?](#developmentreference5---which-directions-can-we-undertake-together)
- [Development.Reference:6 - How does a proposal become feasible joint work?](#developmentreference6---how-does-a-proposal-become-feasible-joint-work)
- [Development.Reference:7 - What help, learning and cultural continuation are needed?](#developmentreference7---what-help-learning-and-cultural-continuation-are-needed)
- [Development.Reference:8 - Can these Methods produce a coherent project document package?](#developmentreference8---can-these-methods-produce-a-coherent-project-document-package)
- [Development.Reference:9 - What changes when capable AI becomes inexpensive?](#developmentreference9---what-changes-when-capable-ai-becomes-inexpensive)
- [Development.Reference:10 - How does the selected practice become usable locally?](#developmentreference10---how-does-the-selected-practice-become-usable-locally)
- [Development.Reference:11 - Where do the answers come from, and when should they change?](#developmentreference11---where-do-the-answers-come-from-and-when-should-they-change)

## Development.Reference:1 - What result are we trying to obtain?

A request for a development office can name a proposed arrangement before anyone has established its useful result. Recover that result first. Does a person need to perform some current work, become able to perform it, organize their own further development, or help others become able to continue? Does a provider need a viable offer, a company need a different capability, or a community need useful participation? These results can depend on each other without being the same.

[DOCA.1 and DOCA.1.CHR](DEVELOPMENT-AND-SELF-DEVELOPMENT-PRACTICE-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#doca1---bound-the-development-opportunity-inquiry) help bound the inquiry and characterize the subject and intended change. [DOCA.7](DEVELOPMENT-AND-SELF-DEVELOPMENT-PRACTICE-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#doca7---bound-the-development-direction-advising-engagement) bounds help when the adviser, recipient, sponsor and choice owner differ. Their result can be a better bounded inquiry or a qualified stop, not a compulsory programme.

Use [Human Capability Development](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/Development%20DPF%20Suite/HUMAN-CAPABILITY-DEVELOPMENT-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) when a person must acquire the ability; use an adequate available service when supplied performance is sufficient. Neither route alone establishes self-development. Continue to the connected undertaking only when the receiving work needs that larger result.

## Development.Reference:2 - Where does development begin, and what happens after success?

Development need not start with a chosen practice or an explicit problem. Recurrent workarounds, a surprising success, an avoided task or a narrowing of attainable possibilities can justify inquiry. The development language's [DOCA.1–4](DEVELOPMENT-AND-SELF-DEVELOPMENT-PRACTICE-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#doca1---bound-the-development-opportunity-inquiry) connects such inquiry to a worthwhile problem, possible directions and the support they need. An adequate established answer can end that inquiry; creating novelty is not a condition of useful work.

[DOCA.9](DEVELOPMENT-AND-SELF-DEVELOPMENT-PRACTICE-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#doca9---construct-and-sustain-a-connected-development-undertaking) connects the proposed transition, its realization and continuation from the changed position. Its worked case shows why successful delivery of the current result is different from the subject becoming able to organize a further development problem. The next problem may be harder because earlier limitations have been removed, but escalation without a worthwhile attainable gain is not development discipline.

For an unknown way to obtain the result, follow [C.39](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#c39---find-and-develop-a-way-to-obtain-a-result) and the Development framework's direct C.40 returns. For improvement of the means of development, follow its E.23.CDI return rather than treating every Method edit as development. A sufficient contribution ends the local inquiry; continuing development opens the next substantive question.

## Development.Reference:3 - How do the different transformations form one undertaking?

Ordinary work, inquiry, changed subject capability, construction of products and Methods, support provision and cultural continuation must supply one another where the intended result depends on them.

Use [DOCA.9:4](DEVELOPMENT-AND-SELF-DEVELOPMENT-PRACTICE-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#doca94---solution). It develops the typical connections and their conditional returns, including an adequate external contribution that changes which work the undertaking must perform itself. The result is a proposed connected undertaking with identifiable receiving contributions and conditions, not an already operating organization. Its worked case provides the construction at a size that can be inspected and adapted.

An actual transformation-flow network claim uses the distinct flow and network rules in [E.18](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#e18---transformation-flow-structure) and [E.18.NET](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#e18net---network-of-transformation-flow-structures). Methods, performed work, receiving dependencies and shared resources remain different relations. If only one adequate contribution is needed, there is no obligation to model a whole network. If a connection cannot be constructed from the supplied Methods, return that missing contribution to its actual practice.

## Development.Reference:4 - Who should perform and support the Methods?

Compare complete arrangements, not office names. The same development work might be performed through ordinary managers and workplaces, a specialist development office, a common service for several masteries, a federation, an external provider or an extensive AI arrangement. Methods, capability, resources and powers must be connected without assuming that their structures coincide.

[ME.6](../Engineering%20DPF%20Suite/METHOD-ENGINEERING-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#me6---compare-method-architecture-alternatives-and-simultaneous-enactment-conflicts) constructs these alternatives from the supplied practice and receiving result. It distinguishes the subject's necessary own contribution from substitutable provision, exposes joint demand and authority, and compares shared and specialized support. Its examples include a company without a new office, voluntary external participants and qualified AI. Current [Organization Change Engineering](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/Engineering%20DPF%20Suite/ORGANIZATION-CHANGE-ENGINEERING-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) supplies the actual organizational design and realization where an organization is the governed subject.

A tunnel-building company may need technical performance, learning and continued development. That does not decide that one office should own all three. A specialist development provider can obtain technical expertise from elsewhere while preserving its own strategic remit. Conversely, a common service can share genuinely common provision without treating every mastery as interchangeable. The Method compares these conditions and their whole costs.

Stop when the current or selected arrangement is sufficient for the next use. Return to ME.6 when the work, capacity, provider, mandate or means change enough to alter that answer. A Method architecture does not itself appoint staff or grant powers.

## Development.Reference:5 - Which directions can we undertake together?

Research, products, people, infrastructure and community work can be independently worthwhile while competing for the same real performers. Ranking each direction separately can promise incompatible work or charge the same common provision several times.

[DOCA.10](DEVELOPMENT-AND-SELF-DEVELOPMENT-PRACTICE-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#doca10---construct-a-feasible-development-portfolio-with-shared-or-branch-specific-support) constructs shared versus branch-specific support, joint demand and feasible combinations. It retains scientific and editorial ends and decisions, and shows when an existing Strategy result already suffices. The [Strategy DPF](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/Development%20DPF%20Suite/STRATEGY-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) supplies direction, offer, programme and bounded commitment Methods; [Research Method Practice](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/Development%20DPF%20Suite/RESEARCH-METHOD-PRACTICE-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) supplies inquiry and its warranted stop.

For a development provider, this means comparing its own development, a shared Method library and independent scientific contributions, B2C/B2B provision, client projects and people/AI/community work alongside current obligations. One real performer has one capacity in the comparison, even when that person fills several roles. Independent mathematical inquiry with no material shared dependency need not acquire a portfolio or office merely to use a development Method. Stop with the sufficient bounded decision; reopen the affected combination when a shared condition changes.

## Development.Reference:6 - How does a proposal become feasible joint work?

An accepted strategy does not supply all the contributions needed to enact it. Nor does telling people about the strategy resolve objections or make incompatible promises feasible.

[Leadership](LEADERSHIP-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) supplies four connected Methods. LDR.1 obtains and continues a missing leadership contribution. LDR.2 negotiates complete feasible contributions. LDR.3 constructs a useful answer through substantive discussion. LDR.4 prepares a proposal through decision, commitments, a mutually understood start and first useful work. This last contribution carries propitka: trusted judgement and examination of consequences can change the proposal before commitment, and first use tests what the agreement actually provided.

Read [LDR.4](LEADERSHIP-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#ldr4---prepare-a-proposal-for-decision-and-first-use) when that whole transition is missing. Open one of the other Methods directly when only its contribution is needed. The independent-community case makes voluntary contribution and refusal visible; no common employer is presumed. An authority or commitment must obtain in the actual setting. Ordinary sufficient coordination needs no special preparation campaign.

## Development.Reference:7 - What help, learning and cultural continuation are needed?

These are different questions with different sufficient answers.

| Missing contribution | Useful entry and result | Ordinary boundary or return |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Help through which an interpretable practice becomes workable | [Practice Implementation Support](PRACTICE-IMPLEMENTATION-SUPPORT-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md), IS.1–5: a bounded help relationship, diagnosis, support strategy, introduction/adaptation and continuation or end | An unknown development direction returns to DOCA; an unknown subject Method returns to its field or Method Engineering. |
| A person must become capable, rather than receive a service | [Human Capability Development](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/Development%20DPF%20Suite/HUMAN-CAPABILITY-DEVELOPMENT-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md): learning purpose, prepared practice, feedback and transfer | Competent provider performance is not evidence of the recipient's learning; adequate existing competence may need only access or support. |
| Useful participation, relationships or joint contributions | [Community Management](COMMUNITY-MANAGEMENT-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md), starting at CB.1 or the known missing Method | Do not create a community when independent use of an available resource is enough. Employment does not by itself establish community participation or voluntary mandate. |
| A practice must continue among further carriers, including independent people, collectives or AI | [C.36](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#c36---cultural-evolution-and-cultural-evolution-engineering) and [C.36.RP](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#c36rp---sustain-and-renew-shared-ways-of-working), with the subject practice's actual sources | Transmission or participation counts do not establish reconstruction, use or capacity to continue. Follow the direct cultural Method even when there is no community organizer. |

For a culture of development, combine the actual cultural continuation contribution with DOCA.9's development result. Reproducing a training activity or one mastered Method does not show that further carriers can notice a consequential difficulty or possibility, construct a worthwhile development problem, and organize the next attainable transition. A local helping undertaking can nevertheless finish legitimately before that larger culture claim is established.

## Development.Reference:8 - Can these Methods produce a coherent project document package?

Use these Methods to construct the content needed for a coherent project package. For example, a development provider may need a connected concept, strategy, project architecture and programmes for its own development and capacity to help clients. Scientific inquiry, a shared Method library, B2C/B2B provision and community contributions can have independent ends while sharing means.

[DOCA.9:4](DEVELOPMENT-AND-SELF-DEVELOPMENT-PRACTICE-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#doca94---solution) constructs the development undertaking and keeps its intended changes and receiving results connected. Sections 4.4–4.9 connect alternatives, organization, performed contributions and further development, then give local work the Method language it needs. Use [STR.6](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/Development%20DPF%20Suite/STRATEGY-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#str6---construct-strategic-option-families-or-develop-reusable-material-for-strategic-exploration) for complete strategic alternatives, [STR.8:4.2a](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/Development%20DPF%20Suite/STRATEGY-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#str842a---explain-why-the-proposed-changes-would-work-together) to explain why changes and already available contributions work together, and [STR.11](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/Development%20DPF%20Suite/STRATEGY-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#str11---select-strategy-portfolio-commitments-and-assumptions) for bounded commitments.

For organization work, use OCE's Methods for [concept alternatives](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/Engineering%20DPF%20Suite/ORGANIZATION-CHANGE-ENGINEERING-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#oce3---generate-and-compare-organization-concepts), [contribution architecture](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/Engineering%20DPF%20Suite/ORGANIZATION-CHANGE-ENGINEERING-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#oce4---design-an-organizations-contribution-architecture), [paired product and organization decisions](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/Engineering%20DPF%20Suite/ORGANIZATION-CHANGE-ENGINEERING-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#oce7---coordinate-product-or-service-and-organization-architecture-decisions), and [bounded realization](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/Engineering%20DPF%20Suite/ORGANIZATION-CHANGE-ENGINEERING-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#oce9---realize-a-bounded-organization-capability-increment). RMP supplies warranted inquiry; HCD, a human learning or development programme; CB, a community arrangement; and Practice Implementation Support, a helping undertaking. ME.6 connects the performance and provision arrangements, and DOCA.10 tests joint feasibility where shared means make that question real. Leadership supplies missing joint contributions to formulation and enactment.

The resulting documents must agree about the subjects, commitments, means and contributions on which they rely. A provider's planned service, work actually delivered and a recipient's new capability remain separate claims. Company assistance stays within the agreed client remit; scientific choice retains its independent criteria.

Stop with the content needed for the next responsible action. When a required content construction is absent from these suppliers, report the missing Method or connection. [The local realization question](#developmentreference10---how-does-the-selected-practice-become-usable-locally) concerns putting those Methods into usable local practice, not relabeling every project document an LPF.

## Development.Reference:9 - What changes when capable AI becomes inexpensive?

Recompare the whole arrangement. A qualified agent may supply inquiry, source recovery, construction, explanation, practice feedback or an authorized decision. The changed viable division of work can remove a specialist bottleneck or an unnecessary office.

Use [ME.6's AI case](../Engineering%20DPF%20Suite/METHOD-ENGINEERING-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#me656---capable-ai-changes-the-whole-arrangement-not-just-the-coachs-speed) and [C.11.DUA](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#c11dua---make-advice-and-evidence-demands-worth-their-burden). Include the actual capability, access, context, powers, qualification, shared capacity and consequences of error. Remove human duplication only when the replacement supplies the contribution on which the receiving result depends. Do not retain people merely because an earlier arrangement had them; do not assume a general capability claim supplies the required local judgement or authorization.

If the intended gain is a human's mastery or self-development, AI performing all of the work can defeat that gain even when the immediate output improves. If the gain is an externally supplied result, requiring the human to learn the provider's Method may add waste. Return to the intended result, then change the performance and support arrangement. The worked costs in these Methods are prospective models, not measured universal savings.

## Development.Reference:10 - How does the selected practice become usable locally?

To realize a selected proposal, the responsible performers need usable Methods, actual means and powers, sufficient preparation, commitments and an entry into real work.

Follow [ME.6:4.9](../Engineering%20DPF%20Suite/METHOD-ENGINEERING-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#me649---give-the-selected-realization-its-exact-contribution-and-conditions) to the actual missing contribution. ME.10 makes Method material usable; OCE.9 realizes an organizational change; Practice Implementation Support provides and adapts the helping undertaking; HCD develops a person's needed capability. An adequate already available contribution ends its branch. A changed result or dependency returns to the supplying Method and the affected whole.

Use [E.4.DPF](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#e4dpf---domain-and-local-principle-frameworks-whether-and-how-to-author-and-publish) when a bounded local practice needs an LPF language. Keep local decisions and examples distinct from the general Method, retain its supplier and conditions, and revise local guidance when those conditions change. A hierarchy of projects does not imply a hierarchy of copied frameworks. A service description, programme, assignment or architecture decision remains its own kind of document.

## Development.Reference:11 - Where do the answers come from, and when should they change?

The [Suite account](README.md#membership) identifies the membership and its separate constitution rules. This Reference selects questions and direct contributions for the stated use; it does not reproduce all member content or claim that all members are necessary for every answer. Core Methods, adjacent disciplines and underlying sources are returned where they matter.

The form adapts [E.11.DSG](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#e11dsg---dpf-suite-reference): begin with a working situation, give a short answer or honest stop, and make the complete supplying Methods available as the question requires. Instructional how-to guidance is the relevant alternative when the reader needs a procedure for a selected task. Here the reader may first need to identify the missing result or supplier, and direct use of a known sufficient DPF remains available. This is a bounded basis for the Reference form; claims about the Methods' effectiveness retain their own evidence requirements. Reconsider the form when another arrangement gives these readers a more truthful or less burdensome answer.

The complete patterns retain their problem, forces, developed solution, examples, evidence limits and source choices. The office-form literature, implementation-support literature, leadership sources and role-community essays contribute at different evidence strengths. Their interpretations and limits are stated in the actual supplying patterns; a recent date, organizational label or illustrative success is not evidence of universal effectiveness.

A changed source or failed use reopens the claim and connection it can alter. A new product edition does not silently change a saved historical answer. If a cited publication is unavailable or the relevant candidate is not yet admitted, the affected answer remains provisional; an accessible title is not a substitute for its full Method. Use another sufficient direct source when available, or retain the specific missing contribution and the condition for retry.

Original content: Anatoly Levenchuk, with AI-assisted development and review. [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) applies to original content; source materials retain their own terms. Authorship and publication do not establish a maintenance commitment.

## Development.Reference:End


# SOURCE_FILE: Development DPF Suite/HUMAN-CAPABILITY-DEVELOPMENT-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md
---
# Human Capability Development Principles Framework


HCD is a pattern language for deriving human capability demand from later Work, designing and sustaining development arrangements, judging human contribution, transfer and retention, and evaluating instructional material under stated audience, task, support and time conditions.

> **Author:** Anatoly Levenchuk with AI-assisted development and review.
> **Version:** 12 October 2026 — twenty-nine-pattern edition
> **Status:** Eternal alpha: used in working development projects and open to continuing correction.
> **License:** [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) for original framework content; third-party material retains its own terms.
> **Publication:** [FPF repository](https://github.com/ailev/FPF). [Citation](#hcdreference9---citation).

# Table of Contents

Use the Readme when you have a working difficulty but do not yet know the direct pattern. Use this Table of Contents when you already know the PatternID. The twenty-nine pattern bodies contain the authoritative practitioner guidance.

`HCD.*` is the PatternID namespace. The numbers are stable addresses, not a Work sequence; HCD.1–HCD.28 and nested HCD.6.1 are available in this edition.

## Public units

# Human Capability Development Principles Framework Readme

## Practical entries

Human Capability Development connects what a person needs to contribute in later work with a feasible way to develop that contribution and evidence of what the person can now do. Tools, AI and providers can support the work; their contribution must remain visible when interpreting the person's performance. Instructional material can also be evaluated and repaired without making a claim about a particular person's development.

The selected examples below show how results from several methods work together. They are not a catalogue, a coverage boundary or stages to complete for every question. If no example matches your question, use the Table of Contents' working questions to enter the smallest relevant pattern. For a question outside human capability development, follow [Framework Boundary and Refresh](#framework-boundary-and-refresh) to the named domain owner. Use an adequate existing result where it fits; return only to the question left open by a missing input or changed condition. The Table of Contents gives direct access to HCD.1–HCD.28 and nested HCD.6.1 in this twenty-nine-pattern edition.

You can ask an assisting agent to explain or apply these methods in the language of your work, without framework jargon, while preserving the distinctions needed for the question.

### HCD-PRODUCT - Build a learning offer before the learners are known

**Situation:** An author has a future audience and intended work, but topics, materials, practice and promised support do not yet form an attainable product.

**Question:** What complete learning route can this audience use, and which subject, material or supply contribution is missing?

**First useful result or blocker:** Comparable whole-product variants for a bounded task family, with entry branches, complete burdens and an exact missing contribution where a connection fails.

**Start with:** [HCD.28 - Construct and Revise a Whole Learning Product for a Future Audience](#hcd28---construct-and-revise-a-whole-learning-product-for-a-future-audience). Its solution explains how to join the contributions; the links below locate the suppliers.

**Stop or return:** Stop with the construction needed for the design or offer decision. Return a missing subject method to its domain owner, a material defect to HCD.19, and unavailable help to HCD.7/.8. When an individual learner becomes known, return usable product variants and requirements to HCD.2 for personal comparison.

Future diagnosticians may calculate an indicator correctly while choosing the wrong model. HCD.28 first checks whether the subject selection criterion is available, implicit in expert action or unresolved. With an adequate subject basis, HCD.5/.6 construct the learning mechanism and task; HCD.7/.8 establish actual assistance. HCD.20 compares individual and group options, and HCD.22 constructs the selected shared task. None of these links makes the group option obligatory. The [constructed whole-product application](#hcdapplication5---app-hcd-04---constructed-whole-learning-product-and-shared-task) shows how the complete load can change the design.

### HCD-GROUP - Make joint activity develop the intended personal contribution

**Situation:** A shared answer is good, but it is unclear what each participant did, or the proposed interaction cannot fit the available people, time and help.

**Question:** Which contributions make learning together useful, and how can the task elicit them under a feasible arrangement?

**First useful result or blocker:** A justified individual or group option and, when needed, a shared task with usable personal actions, material transfers, feedback and recovery.

**Start with:** [HCD.20 - Compose and Compare Arrangements for Individual and Group Learning](#hcd20---compose-and-compare-arrangements-for-individual-and-group-learning) when the configuration is unsettled; enter [HCD.22 - Design Shared Learning Tasks with Necessary Individual Contributions](#hcd22---design-shared-learning-tasks-with-necessary-individual-contributions) directly when the target and arrangement constraints already exist.

**Stop or return:** Stop when the comparison or task changes the next design decision. Return missing qualified help to HCD.7/.8 and a disconnected product route to HCD.28. Personal performance, the common product, team capability and the material's contribution require their respective observations.

A cohort of 24 need not discuss as one group. Two three-minute contributions each plus six minutes of reconciliation give an initial bound of four people in thirty minutes, excluding separate help. The worked construction adds six minutes of qualified help per group and staggers the starts, allowing two mentors to make all six visits before the dependent personal actions. HCD.20 shows the participant and mentor timeline and the changed burden. At a shared instrument, meaningful observation and operator turns produce different constraints; the discussion formula does not determine that group size.

To establish or change actual membership and contact, use [HCD.21](#hcd21---form-and-change-learning-work-groups). To develop understanding through reasons, use [HCD.23](#hcd23---learn-through-explanation-and-comparison-of-solutions); for evaluative judgement and revision, use [HCD.24](#hcd24---learn-evaluation-and-revision-through-peer-review); for a relation that must reach another project, use [HCD.25](#hcd25---learn-transfer-through-comparison-of-projects). A group whose work has drifted can use [HCD.26](#hcd26---regulate-shared-learning), while incompatible preparation, material transfers or return windows lead to [HCD.27](#hcd27---coordinate-personal-learning-routes-with-a-shared-rhythm). Each method returns the actual contribution and its limits to the arrangement.

### HCD-FEASIBLE - Make a development proposal fit the work and available support

**Situation:** A development proposal contains useful topics and exercises, but its complete tasks, learner effort and provider contribution have not been shown to fit together.

**Question:** What can be offered within the available time and support while preserving the intended contribution to later work?

**First useful result or blocker:** A comparable, feasible arrangement or task fragment; otherwise the target, resource or support constraint that prevents the comparison.

**Start with:** [HCD.2 - Compose and Compare Human Capability-Development Programmes for Later Work](#hcd2---compose-and-compare-human-capability-development-programmes-for-later-work) for one known person with compatible work, target and starting evidence. For an author with a future audience, start directly with [HCD.28](#hcd28---construct-and-revise-a-whole-learning-product-for-a-future-audience); its product variants can later supply the personal comparison.

**Stop or return:** Stop with the comparison needed for the present decision. Return a missing support contribution to its provider, a changed intended outcome to its owner, or a non-training cause to the practice that can address it. Programme comparison does not authorize launch.

1. **Establish whose contribution the proposal concerns.** For one person, [HCD.1 - Derive Human Capability Demand from Representative Later Work](#hcd1--derive-human-capability-demand-from-representative-later-work) supplies the required contribution and its basis. [HCD.3 - Diagnose Whether a Capability, Misconception, or Behaviour Limits Work](#hcd3--diagnose-whether-a-capability-misconception-or-behaviour-limits-work) distinguishes a human development target from a tool, access, assignment or other limitation. Where simultaneous work competes for development effort, [HCD.4 - Architect a Balanced Human Capability Profile Across Simultaneous Work](#hcd4--architect-a-balanced-human-capability-profile-across-simultaneous-work) supplies the priorities and contributions to protect. HCD.2 consumes those results in comparing feasible alternatives. For a future audience whose individual learners are not yet known, it returns the design question and available fragments to HCD.28. A product variant returns to HCD.2 only with the named person’s compatible starting evidence, work, support and participation conditions.
2. **Make the alternatives comparable through complete tasks.** In the constructed [programme-design application](#hcdapplication6---application-return-to-a-programme-and-instrument-designer), three compositions each use 340 learner hours over 34 weeks. A change from ten to six hours per week leaves 204 hours: each original proposal exceeds the allowance by 136 hours. HCD.2 asks what work, practice and evidence would be removed or replaced. Merely multiplying allocations by 0.6 does not show that the promised outcomes survive.
3. **Construct the missing development contribution.** Retain the detailed task fragment already available for one option and construct the smallest comparable fragment for another, using the same intended output and audience assumptions. [HCD.5 - Select Human Capability-Development Methods](#hcd5---select-human-capability-development-methods) selects how to develop the target action from the starting evidence, or proposes conditional choices from stated entry assumptions for a future audience; [HCD.6 - Design Representative Practice Tasks](#hcd6---design-representative-practice-tasks) turns that choice into a whole task, criterion, permitted help and relevant variation. If the learner cannot yet notice a distinction required by the task, [HCD.6.1 - Help a Learner Discern a Needed Distinction in Practice](#hcd61---help-a-learner-discern-a-needed-distinction-in-practice) helps design an accessible contrast and use the learner’s response to guide the next attempt. Return the noticed distinction to the whole task; recognizing it does not establish the ability to perform that task. These results let HCD.2 compare what the options actually provide.
4. **Test the support needed at the time of use.** [HCD.7 - Arrange Providers, Access, Tools, and AI Support for Human Capability Development](#hcd7---arrange-providers-access-tools-and-ai-support-for-human-capability-development) uses those tasks to establish actual feedback, assessment, access and capacity. The example's 240 teaching hours divided among twelve participants is a planning allocation, not twenty hours of individual contact each. Doubling participants with unchanged individual checking demand doubles that checking work. [HCD.8 - Obtain or Build Missing Human Capability-Development Support with Bounded Recursion](#hcd8---obtain-or-build-missing-human-capability-development-support-with-bounded-recursion) enters only for a missing contribution that must be obtained or built. Return its cost and operating limits to the comparison.

A useful substitution may emerge from this fragment comparison. It does not yet establish that a complete 204-hour programme exists. Changing the intended outcome is another possible decision, which must be explicit before comparing a narrower offer.

### HCD-EVIDENCE - Decide what a successful attempt permits you to rely on

**Situation:** A learner reaches a correct answer after help, or succeeds in familiar work, and someone needs to decide what this permits them to rely on in later work.

**Question:** Which contribution is supported, under what conditions, and what part of development should change?

**First useful result or blocker:** A bounded performance conclusion and, when needed, a targeted change to the task or assistance; an unresolved transfer, delay or support question remains separate.

**Start with:** [HCD.11 - Assess Human Performance in Representative Work](#hcd11--assess-human-performance-in-representative-work), using the attempt and its actual conditions. If practice is being conducted, [HCD.9 - Perform Deliberate Practice with Feedback](#hcd9---perform-deliberate-practice-with-feedback) preserves the first attempt, supplied help, feedback, learner correction or supported retention. A correction requires a targeted retry; after retaining an action, retry only for a remaining practice question.

**Stop or return:** Stop when the available evidence is sufficient for the intended reliance or local revision. Obtain another observation only for a consequential unresolved claim whose evidence can be obtained at worthwhile cost.

1. **Separate the successful product from the person's contribution.** In the constructed [APP-HCD-02](#hcdapplication3---app-hcd-02---constructed-performance-transfer-retention-and-revision), a teacher initially helps Learner-L17 reject a release proposal supported by the wrong firmware evidence. That correction is assisted. Two later fresh attempts show L17 detecting the mismatch before a teacher or AI cue, supporting a narrower independent configuration-checking conclusion.
2. **Change the condition relevant to the next use.** [HCD.12 - Test Transfer to Unfamiliar Work or Learning from a New Source](#hcd12--test-transfer-to-unfamiliar-work-or-learning-from-a-new-source) uses unfamiliar work when transfer matters. A compatible release case requires two hours per change plus one hour per batch of at most four changes. Ten changes need `20 + 3 = 23` hours and fit a 24-hour allowance. At 22 hours, ten no longer fit; nine need `18 + 3 = 21`. L17's corrected nine-change answer after feedback supports helped resource adaptation while preserving the earlier configuration result.
3. **Repair the development contribution exposed by that result.** [HCD.14 - Revise the Human Capability-Development Arrangement from Evidence](#hcd14--revise-the-human-capability-development-arrangement-from-evidence) can replace a cue-led resource exercise with cases requiring both a justified proposal and a justified refusal. It need not discard sound arithmetic or configuration practice. [HCD.10 - Choose Whether and How to Vary, Space, Interleave, or Progress Practice](#hcd10---choose-whether-and-how-to-vary-space-interleave-or-progress-practice) uses the attempt history to select a consequential variation, separated return, competing task or assistance change; these are different choices, not a fixed progression.
4. **Open a delay or support question only when it affects reliance.** [HCD.13 - Test Human Capability Retention and Dependence on Tools or Other Support](#hcd13--test-human-capability-retention-and-dependence-on-tools-or-other-support) compares performance after a delay and under changed support with suitable earlier conditions. One delayed attempt with AI also removed cannot isolate the effect of delay from the effect of removing AI. Keep intervening practice and remaining tools visible. An immediate local repair need not wait for this separate investigation.

### HCD-CONTINUATION - Keep a useful arrangement while its conditions change

**Situation:** Development already has useful results, but later work, support or a claim about a development method changes; a successful work episode may also raise a question about what to retain or learn next.

**Question:** What should continue for this person, and does the change also affect the method repertoire or a group's development practice?

**First useful result or blocker:** A bounded lesson from successful Work, a continuing arrangement for the person, a decision to retain, revise or stop a specified use of a development method, or a decision about a specified cultural relation. Each uses evidence appropriate to its own question.

**Start with:** [HCD.15 - Sustain Continuing Human Capability Development](#hcd15--sustain-continuing-human-capability-development) for the person's continuing development, using current work and evidence, including an applicable HCD.14 revision. Open a repertoire or culture question only when that is the affected object.

**Stop or return:** Continue what remains adequate. Return a missing allocation to its owner; retain an unresolved comparison when its proposed investigation is not feasible. A change to one use does not by itself establish a population-wide effect.

For an episode that succeeded but whose useful lesson is unclear, start with **HCD.15:4.2.1** and the import case in **HCD.15:5.4**. Connect the person's explanation to the work record, actual help and an alternative account before choosing another application. The result can justify keeping the action and returning to Work.

1. **Locate what changed and what can be retained.** The constructed [APP-HCD-03](#hcdapplication4---app-hcd-03---constructed-continuation-method-repertoire-and-culture) preserves practice in tracing a release claim to its supporting evidence and referring safety or maintenance questions to the relevant specialist, while proposing a replacement for one cue-led correction exercise. HCD.15 uses that result to specify relevant cases, help, responsible providers and reopening conditions for the person. Until the needed learner and provider time is allocated, the affected practice cannot be arranged; the useful prior result remains available. HCD.15:5.3 shows a separate resourced variant: first, helped and fresh attempts lead to a local continuation decision, then an AI change reopens only source access.
2. **Carry evidence to the method claim only when it fits.** [HCD.16 - Keep Human Capability-Development Method Claims Current](#hcd16--keep-human-capability-development-method-claims-current) can use compatible observations from continuing development to retain a supported use or narrow a claim. In the example, retain the method for practising evidence tracing and specialist referral through attempts, feedback, correction and retry. The available result supports performance with help; its contribution to independent learning remains unresolved. The proposed comparison needs three learner hours and two provider hours; only half a provider hour is available. Its useful return is the narrower claim and unresolved comparison. A later resource window may make the probe worthwhile; selecting it supplies no result. Fresh success after both practice episodes can support the observed contribution while leaving each candidate's separate effect unresolved.
3. **Distinguish a group's continuation question.** [HCD.17 - Deliberately Continue and Change Human Capability-Development Culture](#hcd17--deliberately-continue-and-change-human-capability-development-culture) asks about the specified transmission, receiving use, recognition or retention of practice within a population. Its example observes receiving trainers using a teaching sequence after combined preparation and coaching. Reducing refresher coaching for those previously prepared trainers changes that basis: a feasible, authorized comparison can support a branch proposal, while the trainers' later use and the learners' performance remain separate observations. It does not establish that materials alone prepare a new group. The person's performance conclusion alone does not answer this cultural question.

### HCD-MATERIAL - Find what instructional material supports and what to repair

**Situation:** An explanation, worksheet or learning route is meant to support a reader's task, but a correct reader answer may have depended on prior knowledge or help.

**Question:** What did the material supply, what remains missing, and which repair would change its intended use?

**First useful result or blocker:** A compatible evaluation specification, or a supported diagnosis of the material's contribution, limiting defect and repair reach.

**Start with:** [HCD.19 - Evaluate Instructional Material through Representative Reader Work and Diagnose Its Repair](#hcd19---evaluate-instructional-material-through-representative-reader-work-and-diagnose-its-repair) when a compatible specification exists. Otherwise use [HCD.18 - Select or Construct a Characterization and Evaluation Specification for Instructional Material](#hcd18---select-or-construct-a-characterization-and-evaluation-specification-for-instructional-material) to connect the promised task, audience, permitted help, criteria and evidence to the intended decision.

**Stop or return:** Stop with the supported use or repair conclusion and any evidence gap that limits it. Repair the affected material through E.23; use human-performance methods only for a claim about the person's contribution or learning.

1. **Use the specification to decide what must be inspected.** The [instructional-material evaluation profile](#hcdapplication1---instructional-material-evaluation-profile) explains how HCD.18 and HCD.19 work together. Select properties that can change the use or repair decision; a local false relation does not require evaluating an entire course.
2. **Distinguish material contribution from reader repair.** In its Time-use S1 case, an uninterrupted example gives the same value for active effort and elapsed turnaround, so it cannot distinguish the two rules. A prepared reader separates them correctly using prior knowledge. HCD.19 preserves that fact rather than crediting the missing distinction to the material.
3. **Repair the relation and inspect its affected use.** The revised material distinguishes the quantities, changes the columns, adds interruption and population conditions, and supports a changed two-person comparison of three consumed person-hours with four available person-hours. This supports the bounded repair and use, not a novice-learning claim.
4. **Return remaining requirements at their actual reach.** The full specification still requires a concurrent-person example, an inspected task and key, and suitable explanatory and feedback evidence. Keep these gaps visible without withholding the narrower supported repair. Obtain additional reader work only when its result can change the decision enough to warrant its burden.

# Preface

## HCD.Preface:1 - Start from the contribution that later Work needs

Use HCD when a person, manager or development practitioner needs to improve or sustain a human contribution to later Work, and must decide what development is worth attempting under real time, access and support conditions. The question may arise before a programme, during a difficult practice attempt, after a successful assessment, or years later when the Work changes. A learning-product author can also use the framework while the future audience is still an assumption.

The recurring difficulty is connecting a development activity to the contribution it should change. A curriculum may cover every topic while leaving whole tasks out of reach. A good assisted answer may conceal the action the person still cannot supply. A once useful arrangement may become unsuitable after a tool, task or provider changes. HCD makes these differences actionable: identify the required contribution, compare a plausible development change, obtain the support it needs, and judge only what the subsequent observation can establish.

Begin with the decision now in front of you. State whose contribution matters, in what later Work, what is already known, and which result would change the next action. Then enter the relevant body through the [Practical entries](#practical-entries). The first useful result can be small: a demand hypothesis, two comparable task fragments, a corrected practice attempt, one qualified performance claim, or an exact missing contribution to obtain. A known person needs compatible personal evidence; an author without named learners can proceed directly to [HCD.28](#hcd28---construct-and-revise-a-whole-learning-product-for-a-future-audience), which constructs the product before personal comparison through HCD.2.

The main choices concern complete-task attainability, preservation of useful existing contributions, and the effort displaced by development. More practice, realism, independence, assessment or provider preparation can improve one condition while making the whole arrangement too burdensome or changing the task being judged. Select these contributions for the live question and compare their combined demands. The [programme and instrument application](#hcdapplication6---application-return-to-a-programme-and-instrument-designer) makes that whole-arrangement constraint concrete.

## HCD.Preface:2 - What the framework connects


Human Capability Development deliberately changes a human holder's capability for intended later Work. It is not every change in behaviour, every use of instruction, or every problem involving a person. A demand account states what later Work requires; a diagnostic target names what may need to change; a profile describes contribution claims; a programme sets out a bounded development arrangement; HCD.2 composes and compares programme candidates. Learning Work and clinical treatment are performed activities. Assessment provides observations and bounded inferences about performance, transfer, or retained capability. Programme, employment and other consequential decisions require their own authority.

HCD.1–HCD.17 keep one exact human holder or bounded HCD population, later Work, conditions, direct-owner results, finite resources, evidence, uncertainty and receiving decision aligned. Demand, diagnosis, profile, programme comparison, Method selection, practice-task design, support arrangement, bounded provider or environment development, focused practice, practice progression, performance assessment, transfer, retention, revision, continuing arrangement, HCD Method-repertoire change and cultural continuation can each be entered directly when their qualified inputs already exist. Their PatternIDs are stable addresses; file order and numbering do not prescribe Work order.

FPF supplies the transdisciplinary distinctions used here: human and other Systems, capability holders, Methods and MethodDescriptions, Work and results, evidence, architecture, decision objects, agency, authority, and precise plain language. Direct human-learning and behaviour sources supply bounded mechanism and evidence claims. Target-domain and specialist sources provide criteria and evidence for correctness, criticality, safety, clinical, legal, and employment questions. Qualified specialists exercise professional judgement, and authorized actors make the corresponding decisions.

HCD.28 connects programme, material, practice and actual supply as a learning product for an audience. HCD.20 compares individual and group arrangements; HCD.22 designs a shared task when interaction supplies a needed contribution. HCD.21 establishes membership and actual contact; HCD.23–25 develop explanation, evaluative exchange and cross-project learning. HCD.26 regulates the current shared attempt, and HCD.27 connects personal routes with useful shared occasions. A personal action, a common work product and a team capability have different bearers and evidence. These methods let a designer join their contributions without treating one result as all three.

HCD.18 and HCD.19 address a different immediate object: the instructional material's contribution under a declared audience, task, and support arrangement. Their specification and diagnosis can improve a learning product before particular learners are known. Actual learning and personal capability remain human-evidence questions; the material result is neither a personal profile nor a whole-programme conclusion.

## HCD.Preface:3 - Human demand, capability evidence, development revision and transformation remain distinct

`HCD.1` derives what a human holder must contribute in later Work. It does not establish the holder's current capability. `HCD.3` identifies a supported limiting target or returns the question elsewhere. It does not select an intervention. `HCD.4` compares current and target claim rows and may support one bounded choice. It does not create a programme, learning trajectory, performed development Work, or transformation.

`HCD.2` composes and compares feasible programme candidates for one person's later Work, including complete contributions, burdens, support dependence and evidence needs; it does not choose or launch a programme. When no particular person is yet known, it returns the learning-product question to HCD.28. HCD.28 supplies conditional variants, not a diagnosis or programme assignment for each future member. `HCD.5` selects a development Method for a qualified target and starting attempt, or proposes conditional Methods with entry evidence for a future audience. Neither result is an effectiveness finding. `HCD.6` designs a sufficiently whole, criterion-bearing practice task without treating surface realism as representation. Its nested `HCD.6.1` helps a learner discern a needed difference, use it and separate it from an incidental cue. That preparatory teaching operation returns to whole-task use and preserves the difference between recognition and performance.

`HCD.7` establishes the provider, access, source, tool, AI, environment, human-check, capacity and fallback contributions required by a bounded use. `HCD.8` compares obtaining an exact missing contribution with building it, follows only the first blocking dependency, and requires an operating test. `HCD.9` preserves the first attempt, actual help, information-bearing feedback and the learner's response. It requires a targeted retry after correction; supported retention can end the episode when no question remains. `HCD.10` selects variation, spacing, retrieval, source, interleaving, support and challenge conditions separately across episodes.

HCD.11 returns observations and a bounded capability inference. HCD.12 tests a material unfamiliar variation. HCD.13 compares delayed performance and support conditions. HCD.14 uses an affected observation to revise a development assumption. A correct first attempt, a correction after feedback, learning from a newly supplied source, delayed performance, transfer, retention and a causal development effect are separately reportable.

HCD.15 configures a continuing arrangement from material Work or evidence changes, including a useful question qualified from successful Work; it is not a calendar, performed development Work or achieved capability. HCD.16 returns the strongest supported bounded use, narrowed claim, unresolved comparison or real protection stop for an exact admitted Method or status-preserved candidate and human-development claim. A selected change or probe needs an obtainable contribution worth the complete learner/provider burden; the result neither admits nor universally retires a Method.
